name: Custom Product Type for WooCommerce (Add-Ons, Data, Options, Booking, and Appointments)
author: WPSAAD

sections.description:
The Custom Product Type for WooCommerce plugin is your ultimate tool for crafting unique product types with advanced features. By integrating add-ons, data options, and booking functionalities, it caters to businesses looking for customization, control, and seamless user experience. Whether it’s selling books, tickets, classes, or appointments, this plugin delivers everything you need for a dynamic WooCommerce store. 💡

With this plugin you can create multiple product types with diffrent data, addons , options and featrues. Also you can use the product categories and attributes in addons fields.

Multilingual and Translation-Ready: The plugin is fully compatible with translation plugins like WPML, making it effortless to create a multilingual WooCommerce store. Deliver a localized experience to your customers in any language.

Payment Gateway Compatibility: Seamlessly works with all WooCommerce payment gateways. The plugin integrates custom fields into the single product page, ensuring no limitations on payment or checkout options.

Key Features

Free Features:

Sutable for creating product data option to be displayed in and managed through the custom product type tab.

  • Custom Product Types: Easily create tailored product types for your store.
  • Custom Taxonomies: Organize and categorize products effectively with additional taxonomy options.
  • Custom Badges: Highlight specific product types with labels such as “Exclusive” or “Best Seller.”
  • Shortcode Integration: Display custom product types anywhere on your site using: `[cwpt_products product_type=”your_product_type”]`
  • Data Placement Control: Place fields in key locations on product pages:
    • Before/after the product title.
    • Before/after the “Add to Cart” button.
    • Before/after product meta.
  • Custom Tabs in WooCommerce Admin: Add WooCommerce-compatible fields to admin tabs, enabling advanced data options for each product type. Available fields include:
    • Text
    • Textarea
    • Select
    • Radio
    • Checkbox
  • Show/Hide from Shop Pages: Choose whether to display custom product types on shop pages or not.

Premium Add-On Features:

Unleash the power of WooCommerce and enhance your product pages with advanced add-ons and options fields. Allow users to select their options or book your products/services with fields that make every product type idea fully executable:

  • Text Fields: Allow users to input custom details (e.g., “Add a name for engraving”).
  • Checkboxes: Perfect for optional add-ons (e.g., “Add Gift Wrapping”).
  • Dropdowns: Offer variations like sizes or colors (e.g., “Select T-Shirt Size”).
  • Radio Buttons: Simplify single-choice options (e.g., “Basic” vs. “Premium”).
  • Textarea: Collect detailed instructions or notes (e.g., “Special Instructions”).
  • Other Fields:
    • Link
    • Price
    • Email
    • Color Picker
    • File Upload
    • WYSIWYG Editor
    • Date Picker
    • Booking Calendar
    • Taxonomy Fields: Select Taxonomy, Radio Taxonomy, Multicheck Taxonomy, etc.

Interactive Calendar for Bookings:

Enable customers to schedule appointments, book classes, or reserve tickets directly from product pages. Examples include:

  • Booking lessons or personal training sessions.
  • Reserving tickets for events or performances.
  • Scheduling consultations or service appointments.

Popular Use Cases

  • Books: Add fields for author names, editions, or personalized notes.
  • Event Tickets: Offer add-ons like VIP upgrades or meal options.
  • Classes and Workshops: Allow users to book specific dates or times.
  • Food Orders: Customize meals with extra toppings or special requests.
  • Services: Enable appointment booking for salons, clinics, or consultations.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to `/wp-content/plugins/`.
  2. Activate the plugin from the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to “Product Types” under WooCommerce settings to create and manage custom product types.
sections.faq:
Why Choose This Plugin?

Custom Product Type for WooCommerce bridges the gap between add-on plugins and booking tools, delivering a comprehensive solution for any business. Unlike competitors like YITH WooCommerce Product Add-Ons (focused on add-ons) or Bookly (specialized in booking), this plugin offers:

  • Combined functionalities for add-ons, options, and bookings.
  • Seamless WooCommerce integration for optimal performance.
  • Tailored product types with dedicated admin and display controls.
  • Compatibility with multilingual and translation plugins like WPML for global reach.
  • Integration with all WooCommerce payment gateways, ensuring flexible and efficient checkout experiences.

What can this plugin do?

It allows you to create unique WooCommerce products with custom fields, add-ons, booking features, and advanced options to cater to any business need.

How to Use Custom Product type for WooCommerce?

After activation, visit the “Product Types” tab in WooCommerce to create tailored product types and manage their settings effortlessly.
